note_16_commitments.title: Note 16 - Commitments and Contingencies: Unconditional Obligations
note_16_commitments.quote: The Company’s unconditional obligations are non-cancelable contractual commitments primarily related to the Company’s investments in AI infrastructure and third-party cloud capacity arrangements and other service arrangements. It also includes the Company’s commitments under the Spectrum Transaction, which are payable in cash and in the Company’s Class A common stock. Refer to Note 6 - Intangible Assets and Goodwill for additional details.

note_10_leases.title: Note 10 - Leases
note_10_leases.quote: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, there were no material changes in the Company’s lease portfolio since December 31, 2025.

note_3_revenue_backlog.title: Note 3 - Revenue: Backlog
note_3_revenue_backlog.quote: Backlog totaled $47,461 million as of June 30, 2026, of which $14,286 million was recognized as deferred revenue at June 30, 2026. Approximately 56% is expected to be recognized within one year, and approximately 34% is expected to be recognized between one and three years, with the remaining 10% to be recognized thereafter.

note_11_leases.title: Note 11 - Leases: Uncommenced operating leases
note_11_leases.quote: The above tables exclude operating lease agreements that have been signed as of December 31, 2025, but not yet commenced for the aggregate lease payments of $1,627 million and an average lease term of 7.2 years, including the operating lease arrangement with Stateline. Refer to Note 9, Investments in unconsolidated affiliates for additional details.

note_6_leases.title: Note 6 - Leases
note_6_leases.quote: Future lease payments under operating leases as of March 31, 2026 are as follows: ... Total operating lease liabilities: RMB 21,726 million (undiscounted RMB 26,837 million).
note_6_leases.uncommenced_leases_note: No uncommenced operating leases disclosed in Note 6 or elsewhere in the financial statements.

note_27_commitments.title: Note 27 - Commitments
note_27_commitments.capital_commitments_quote: The Company’s capital commitments primarily relate to capital expenditures contracted for purchase of property and equipment, including the construction of corporate campuses. Total capital commitments contracted but not provided for amounted to RMB 45,321 million and RMB 54,136 million as of March 31, 2025 and 2026, respectively.
note_27_commitments.other_commitments_quote: The Company also has other commitments including commitments for co-location and bandwidth fees, licensed copyrights and marketing expenses. As of March 31, 2026: No later than 1 year: RMB 57,441 million; Later than 1 year and no later than 5 years: RMB 133,598 million; More than 5 years: RMB 9,023 million; Total: RMB 200,062 million.

note_2t_revenue_practical_expedient.title: Note 2(t) - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies: Revenue recognition
note_2t_revenue_practical_expedient.quote: The Company applies the practical expedient to not disclose the value of unsatisfied performance obligations for contracts with an original expected duration of one year or less and contracts for which revenue is recognized at the amount to which the Company has the right to invoice for services performed.
note_2t_revenue_practical_expedient.reason: Explicit adoption of ASC 606 practical expedient; unsatisfied performance obligations are not disclosed.

note_1_revenue_rpo.title: Note 1 - Description of Business and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies: Revenue
note_1_revenue_rpo.quote: Additionally, we have performance obligations, primarily related to AWS, associated with commitments in customer contracts for future services that we expect to fulfill but have not yet been recognized in our financial statements. For contracts with original terms that exceed one year, those commitments not yet recognized were approximately $244 billion as of December 31, 2025. The weighted average remaining life of our long-term contracts is 4.1 years. The amount and timing of revenue recognition will be driven by customer usage and our performance in accordance with contractual obligations, which can extend beyond the original contractual duration and commitment.
